mapper.content:
Hi {{44.`2`}},

Your AI-generated post is ready for review.

Please open the Content Calendar here to review the full post:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VZFJALbw7Fcu03MnARbq6Sg_ADiQ_OVkiCUK2HxXi0s/edit?usp=sharing

Find your post using this ID: {{49.Post_id}}

In the "Approval Status" column, choose one: - Approved – we'll get it ready to publish as it is. - Needs Edit – add what you'd like changed in the "Reviewer Comment" column, and we'll regenerate it automatically. - Rejected – the post won't move forward.

Warning❌❌ :
You are only allowed to edit the "Approval Status" and "Reviewer Comment"(where you can write what you want the AI o add or remove from the content if and only if you select the "Needs Editing" option ) sections
Do not edit any other Tab as it will distortk the automation process
